title: Addition Word Problems Within 20
description: Solve addition word problems within 20 using picture groups, ten-frames, part-part-whole models, drawings, and three-addend equations.
learningFocus: Use addition within 20 to solve result-unknown, change-unknown, and start-unknown word problems, then add three whole numbers whose sum is within 20.
adultGuidance: Read each story aloud and ask your child what is known, what is missing, and what unit the answer should name. Encourage pictures, counters, or equations as helpful tools; on Page 4, children draw the starting group rather than the final total, and the separate answer key is for adults only.
